harm the environment: Many people do not realize that even a little plastic waste can harm the environment in ways we cannot easily see.
許多人沒有意識到，即使是一點塑膠垃圾也可能以我們不易察覺的方式傷害環境。
harm one's reputation: Posting rude comments online can harm your reputation and make it harder to find a good job later.
在網路上發表無禮的留言可能損害你的名聲，讓你日後更難找到好工作。
do more harm than good: Eating too many vitamin pills may do more harm than good, so you should ask a doctor before taking them.
吃太多維他命可能弊多於利，所以服用前應該先請教醫生。
mean no harm: The little boy pulled the cat's tail, but he meant no harm; he just wanted to play with it.
小男孩拉了貓尾巴，但他並無惡意；他只是想跟牠玩。
harness solar energy: More and more homes in southern Taiwan install panels on their roofs to harness solar energy for electricity.
台灣南部越來越多住家在屋頂裝設面板，利用太陽能來發電。
harness one's talents: A good teacher helps students harness their talents and turn their interests into real skills.
好老師會幫助學生善用才能，把興趣轉化成真正的技能。
harness the power of: Scientists are trying to harness the power of ocean waves to produce clean electricity for coastal towns.
科學家正嘗試駕馭海浪的力量，為沿海城鎮生產乾淨的電力。
harvest crops: Farmers usually harvest crops like rice in early summer and again in late autumn in central Taiwan.
在台灣中部，農民通常在初夏和晚秋收割稻米等作物。
harvest data: Some free apps secretly harvest data about their users, such as where they go and what they buy.
有些免費應用程式會偷偷蒐集使用者的數據，例如他們去哪裡、買什麼。
harvest organs: With the family's permission, doctors were able to harvest organs from the donor and save the lives of five patients.
在家屬同意下，醫生得以從捐贈者身上摘取器官，挽救了五名病人的性命。
reap the harvest: After months of hard work in the fields, the villagers were happy to reap the harvest and celebrate together.
在田裡辛勤工作數月後，村民們很高興能收成並一起慶祝。
hasten to add: The movie was boring, but I hasten to add that the music and costumes were absolutely beautiful.
這部電影很無聊，但我要趕緊補充，它的音樂和服裝非常漂亮。
hasten the process: Adding a little sugar to the water can hasten the process of growing yeast when you make bread at home.
在家做麵包時，在水裡加一點糖可以加快酵母生長的流程。
hasten someone's death: Doctors warned that his heavy smoking would hasten his death if he did not quit soon.
醫生警告說，如果他不趕快戒菸，大量吸菸會加速他的死亡。
hasten home: When the dark clouds rolled in, the children hastened home before the heavy rain began to fall.
烏雲湧來時，孩子們在大雨落下前趕回家。
hatch a plan: The students hatched a plan to throw a surprise birthday party for their teacher without her knowing.
學生們密謀了一個計畫，要在老師不知情的情況下為她辦一場驚喜生日派對。
hatch a plot: In the novel, two jealous brothers hatch a plot to steal the king's crown and take over the country.
在小說中，兩個嫉妒的兄弟策劃陰謀，要偷走國王的王冠並奪取國家。
eggs hatch: The farmer told us that the eggs hatch in about three weeks if the mother hen keeps them warm.
農夫告訴我們，如果母雞讓蛋保持溫暖，蛋大約三週就會孵化。
hatch an idea: While waiting for the bus, Tom suddenly hatched an idea for a phone app that helps students share notes.
在等公車時，湯姆突然想出一個點子，要做一款幫學生分享筆記的手機應用程式。
haul someone into court: The angry neighbors threatened to haul the company into court if it kept dumping waste into the river.
憤怒的鄰居威脅，如果那家公司繼續把廢棄物倒進河裡，就要把它送上法庭。
a long haul: Learning a new language is a long haul, so don't give up if you can't speak well after only a few months.
學一門新語言是一段漫長歷程，所以如果只學了幾個月還說不好，別放棄。
haul in profits: The small bakery began to haul in profits after a famous blogger praised its pineapple cakes online.
一位知名部落客在網路上稱讚那家小麵包店的鳳梨酥後，它開始大賺一筆。
haul the boat: The fishermen worked together to haul the boat onto the beach before the typhoon arrived.
漁夫們在颱風來臨前合力把船拖上沙灘。
be haunted by memories: Years after the war ended, the old soldier continued to be haunted by memories that visited him like ghosts every night.
戰爭結束多年後，這位老兵仍被回憶糾纏，那些回憶每晚都像鬼魂般找上他。
the problem haunts us: We thought the leaking roof was fixed, but the problem haunts us like a ghost every time it rains.
我們以為漏水的屋頂已經修好了，但每次下雨，這個問題就像鬼魂一樣陰魂不散。
a haunted house: Nobody in our village dares to go near a haunted house on the hill because people say ghosts walk there at night.
我們村裡沒有人敢靠近山丘上的一間鬼屋，因為大家說晚上有鬼魂在那裡出沒。
haunt the bars: After losing his job, he began to haunt the bars downtown every night, drinking alone until closing time.
失業後，他開始每晚常泡在市中心的酒吧，獨自喝到打烊。
hazard a guess: I don't know her exact age, but if I had to hazard a guess, I would say she is about forty.
我不知道她確切的年紀，但如果要我大膽猜測，我會說她大約四十歲。
hazard one's life: The firefighter was willing to hazard his life to carry the crying child out of the burning building.
那名消防員願意拿命冒險，把哭泣的孩子從燃燒的建築中抱出來。
a fire hazard: Piling old newspapers next to the heater is a fire hazard, so please move them away right now.
把舊報紙堆在暖氣旁邊是火災隱患，所以請立刻把它們移開。
